params.rate_desc: Flat 4.55% rate (SB 69) less the taxpayer tax credit: 6% of that tax year's federal standard deduction, reduced by 1.3% of income over the 2024 phase-out of $17,652 ($35,304 joint), which also applies to earlier years. The credit base uses the federal standard deduction only; the itemized path and the per-dependent exemption ($2,046 for 2024, $2,111 for 2025) are not computed. Dependent exemptions are not included.
params.rate_desc_2025: Flat 4.50% rate (HB 106 of 2025) less the taxpayer tax credit: 6% of the $15,750 ($31,500 joint) federal standard deduction, reduced by 1.3% of income over $18,213 ($36,426 joint). The credit base uses the federal standard deduction only; the itemized path and the per-dependent exemption ($2,046 for 2024, $2,111 for 2025) are not computed. Dependent exemptions are not included.
params.rate_desc_2026: Flat 4.45% rate (SB 60 of 2026) less the taxpayer tax credit: 6% of the $16,100 ($32,200 joint) federal standard deduction, reduced by 1.3% of income over $18,213 ($36,426 joint). The credit base uses the federal standard deduction only; the itemized path and the per-dependent exemption ($2,046 for 2024, $2,111 for 2025) are not computed. Dependent exemptions are not included.
